Spotlight on our 2015 RawFest Sponsors

Join us in the next 4 weeks getting to know the Sponsors for our Annual RawFest, who have graciously stepped up to make this annual event a possibility.  We are honored to have them as part of the Hippocrates Community, and appreciate not only what they do, but who they are.

Join us on October 31, 2015 from 10 AM-4 PM at Hippocrates Annual RawFest

Grow Good Health with The Tower Garden

Tower Garden® simplifies traditional gardening, using a unique vertical garden system that makes it easy to grow your own fresh fruits and vegetables at home.

The vertical garden, powered by aeroponics

Tower Garden gives you more control of your and your family’s health by making it easy to grow nutritious, great-tasting vegetables and fruits at home. And it’s a smart choice, both environmentally and economically.

Because of its unique aeroponic technology and vertical design, Tower Garden uses less than 10% of the water and land required by traditional, soil-based agriculture. And a recent study by the University of Mississippi found it also generates 30% more produce than soil-based growing methods.

Eat local: from Tower to table

It’s tough to get more local than your own backyard! With Tower Garden, eating local has never been easier. Our aeroponic vertical garden system cuts your carbon footprint by recycling natural resources, potentially reducing pesticide use, and virtually eliminating the need to ship and store produce.

For more information on The Tower Garden visit http://www.JPFL4U.com click on Tower Garden tab at top of page or contact Christina Daugirdas at (561) 719-1394

Pure Choice Skin Care

At Pure Choice Holistic SkINside-OUT Studio, we believe every little thing matters that comes into direct contact with your face & body. In today’s stressful & toxic filled world, consumers are hard pressed to find the time in educating themselves about common toxic practices of the cosmetic manufacturing industry today. In contrast, this precise reason is why it is our passion at to take the time to really educate our clients in recognizing what is truly safe for their family’s daily use, both at home and in the treatment room.

Lisa Johnson-Stuart, founder and Master Clinical Esthetician has carefully designed an extraordinarily pure skin care program, setting the standard way above and beyond the competition. This program promotes outstanding results without the need for injecting toxic substances, paying for highly priced treatments or even going under the knife to obtain the benefits of beautiful and radiant skin. ALL our treatments are not only 100% Pure, Organic, Wild-Harvested & Natural but also include an array of methodically selected professional tools and equipment that further enhance each individual’s results. With Lisa’s proper guidance and client’s commitment, the relationships she holds with her clients have proven to be nothing short of highly regarded & respectful. She has established an honest reputation for holistically nurturing all her client’s needs and concerns in the most healing and relaxing environment possible.

Chunkie Dunkies

Chunkie Dunkies was an inspiration that came to me after I was fortunate enough to work in the Hippocrates Kitchen and then complete their 9 week Health Educator Course in 2010. Because of my amazing education and new experience with Raw Foods I only wanted to eat food that was simple, clean and pure. But... I still loved my sweeter foods and began experimenting with raw nuts and sprouted buckwheat groats (a Hippocrates staple). Within a short period of time, I created my first raw chocolate chip cookie and I was in heaven! It tasted so good and it only had a few ingredients.

Thought there had to be others out there that craved the same, so I went for it. Within one month I developed 5 new flavors (Carrot Cake, Oatmeal Raisin Walnut, Almond Butter Crunch, Mint Chocolate Chip and Cashew Lemon Cream) and began selling them at the local green market in Palm Beach Gardens, FL.

Now four years later, we offer 13 different products, sold in over 100 locations (which can be found on our website) and sell online at www.chunkiedunkies.com Our Cookies, Brownies and Biscotti are Raw, Vegan, Gluten-Free, Dairy-Free, Non-GMO, Paleo-Friendly and Kosher, handmade in our 100% plant-based, gluten-free facility in Riviera Beach, FL. They are either sweetened with organic maple syrup, organic raw blue agave or liquid stevia (Stevita brand). We currently sell two biscotti flavors in the Hippocrates Store and on their website. Almond Lemon Cream and our Newest Flavor - Vanilla Almond Crunch. We will continue to grow our stevia line of treats because we know how important it is to have this option available for our health.

I love food, especially when it’s pure and delicious. Our main goal is to continuously educate those that healthy food can be Gourmet and Satisfying. And now, when we are out and about, demonstrating Chunkie Dunkies, nothing puts a smile on my face more than when a new, unsuspecting customer tries a bite for the first time and is WOWED by our flavors. :)

Health & Happiness, Dina Lauro, Founder/Raw Vegan Chef
